resources.string: Press and hold the button to lock.
When locked, only the home screen is left: the Apps, Widgets and Settings buttons disappear and tiles cannot be removed. To unlock, press and hold the padlock on the home screen.
Choose what is easiest to read: Light, Dark, or High contrast (white on black).
Choose which home screen the phone shows when you press Home. Pick “%1$s” to keep this one.
Opens the phone’s own settings, for example Wi-Fi, sound, brightness and text size.
